scope: Retrospective role adjudication over the current implemented catalogue; not original search screening or a new full-text review.

rules.include: Existing verified extraction identifies a published primary architectural mechanism used by a current implemented model, its source task and dataset, a source locator and an explicit transfer limitation.
rules.direct_evidence: Requires comparable BTC daily sigma7 task, horizon, target and information set; none of these nine source studies is labelled direct evidence by the existing extraction.
rules.foundational_exception: Wang 2016 lies outside the ordinary2017–2026 window; retain as an explicitly declared foundational architecture source for FCN and ResNet, counted once.
rules.exclusion_from_performance_ranking: Do not rank unrelated UCR classification, pollution forecasting and benchmark long-horizon forecasting metrics as target-task comparable P.
rules.selection_independence: Final test A2 or E2 model scores are not read or used to choose bibliographic sources.
